scope: Read-only donor source audit for temporary human/animal NPC rendering, hurt reactions and equipped apparel

findings.hurt: Damage notifications drive flash and jitter; textures alone do not animate.
findings.clothing: Worn-apparel graphics use body type, facing, layer order and draw color; inventory icons are distinct.
findings.native_authority: Qud damage, equipped-item/body-slot state and turn progression must remain authoritative.
